case_title: Rajib Ranjan & Ors. v. R. Vijaykumar
neutral_facts: The Chhattisgarh State Electricity Board issued a tender for work at Hasedeo Thermal Power Station. The respondent submitted an application but it was rejected due to incomplete documents. The respondent filed a complaint alleging that the tender documents were not issued to him. He made several requests for the documents but failed to provide the necessary information. The tender committee sought information from the Chief Engineer of JSEB, who submitted a report stating that the respondent's work was unsatisfactory. Technical experts also found the respondent's work unsuitable. The tender was rejected based on these findings. The respondent filed a civil suit, which was withdrawn and dismissed. He then filed a criminal complaint alleging conspiracy and forgery. The High Court dismissed the petition to quash the complaint, but the Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside the High Court's order, finding the criminal complaint was a misuse of the process of law.
